LOCAL OR EDITOR AGENT

Download, preview, install.

  1. Download the installer and toolkit source, unzip it, and open a terminal in its folder. Python 3.9+ is required.
  2. Replace [PROJECT_FOLDER] with your project’s folder path.
  3. Run the preview first, then the install command.

↺

Updates keep a way back.

Run the installer again from an updated download. Unchanged skills are skipped; changed folders are backed up before replacement. Your custom edits are preserved in the backup.
